description: This file defines a class `SawVoice` which extends `SynthVoice`. It implements a sawtooth oscillator with an ADSR envelope for use in a synthesizer. The class manages oscillator properties, handles note on/off events, and renders audio output by combining oscillator and envelope outputs.

classes.name: SawVoice
classes.description: A class representing a sawtooth wave oscillator with an ADSR envelope, extending the `SynthVoice` class to produce a specific instrument voice for a synth.

methods.name: SawVoice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the oscillator and envelope objects.

methods.name: createOscillator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new `SawOscillator` instance.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Handles note on event, setting pitch and amplitude, and activating the envelope.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Handles note off event, releasing the envelope.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Adjusts the frequency scaling of the oscillator.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the current audio sample by combining oscillator and envelope outputs.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the envelope has finished its release phase.
